text: The provincial Hof van Holland banned Baruch Spinoza's Theologico-Political Treatise on 19 July 1674. The book had already been banned in a few Dutch towns, where copies had been seized from local bookshops, although a writer in 1673 wrongly assumed that it had been proscribed in an official province-wide placard. A Vatican ban followed in 1679.
